svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Architecture
svg.desc: The publisher reference implements draft forward only: no complete verification, acceptance or rollback loop is provided. The technical report describes conditional acceptance probabilities, prefix-survival estimates, and verification length chosen using profiled engine throughput and current load. The exact acceptance and rollback coordinator remains unavailable in the inspected code. Draft parameter count is unpublished and excluded from the backbone ledger; no acceptance rate or speedup is inferred.
